newsitem.title: CHILE: SOCCER-ZAMORANO CONFIDENT OF FACING COLOMBIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ZAMORANO CONFIDENT OF FACING COLOMBIA.

text.p: Chilean forward Ivan Zamorano is recovering rapidly from a back injury suffered in training and should be fit to play in the World Cup qualifier against Colombia on Saturday, the team doctor said Monday.
"I'm a guy who recovers pretty quickly from injuries," said Zamorano, who plays for the Italian club Internazionale. "I don't feel any pain now, except when I bend to the side."
Zamorano collapsed in pain on Friday at a training match after pulling a muscle in his lower back.
